hook: Zerodha's Blobasaur: distributed, high-performance blob storage on SQLite
hookText: Zerodha's Blobasaur: distributed, high-performance blob storage on SQLite

beats.say: Zerodha built Blobasaur, an open-source sharded blob server in Rust that speaks the Redis protocol and stores data in SQLite, serving thousands of multi-KB-to-MB JSON blob reads and writes per second.
Kite, Zerodha's trading platform with about 20 million customers, stores chart layouts, indicator templates and workspace preferences as opaque blobs from a few KB to several MB.
At 25,324 HSET operations per second, each carrying a 64 KiB payload, Blobasaur processes roughly 1.66 GB/s of uncompressed JSON through zstd.
